_: Tim's and Frank's mouth shapes (lib/lipsync.ts), the Hanna-Barbera / Preston Blair set as Rhubarb Lip Sync names it. Each is how the mouth is, not a picture: jaw (how far it opens, 0-1), width (of the opening, a share of the mouth line), round (corners in, lips out), press (lips tight together), teeth (upper teeth showing). scripts/tim_mouth.py and frank_mouth.py draw them from the picture; pieces says which drawn piece stands in for each until it has its own (an index into MOUTHS in app/(tabs)/tim.tsx). mood is how the mouth is at rest, the other axis: shapes are drawn on it.
